rules.condition: Prototype lacked a metastability model, reset in mid random traffic and APB protocol assertions
rules.statement: Metastability behaviour, reset in the middle of random traffic and the APB protocol assertions shall be verified on the RTL.

rules.condition: Quick run on delivered RTL, 16 configurations, synthesis and simulation branches, seeds 1 to 3
rules.statement: Every quick-run simulation on the RTL must finish with zero failures, zero assertion failures and no assertion left unexercised.

rules.condition: Every third configuration, and every third APB5 configuration
rules.statement: Every third configuration uses a requester changing fields in the Access phase to check Setup values are used, and every third APB5 configuration uses a requester never driving PWAKEUP.

rules.condition: Simulating the 12 plan waveforms on the RTL
rules.statement: All 12 RTL waveforms must match the figure WaveJSON, internal rows included, and assertions must pass in the metastability branch for each scenario.

rules.condition: Fault whose effect is a timing property only, equivalent in simulation (completer side loading request register every cycle)
rules.statement: The fault of the completer side loading its request register every cycle instead of at the request event must be shown by the structural check (TEST-015) and the SDC (TEST-016).
PSLVERR must be high only in the PREADY cycle.

rules.condition: Legal extremes: ADDR_W 1 and 32, DATA_W 8/16/32, user widths 0 and maximum, CELL_TYPE 1 to 4
rules.statement: Elaboration, lint and simulation must pass for the legal parameter extremes.
